Answer: D
Reason: The imaging progression shows severe bilateral alveolar infiltrates (Figure 3) that resolve rapidly to near-normal lungs (Figure 4a), a pattern characteristic of Exercise-Induced Pulmonary Haemorrhage (EIPH) following intense exertion, whereas ARDS or pneumonia would typically have a slower resolution and cardiogenic edema would show cardiomegaly.
